tools.name: list_verticals
tools.description:
List all booking verticals Agentorist currently supports.

Returns a dict with each vertical's name and description. Call this first
to discover what's bookable before constructing other tool calls.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for bookable items within a vertical.

vertical.description:
One of the names returned by list_verticals (e.g. "movies",
"events", "experiences", "hotels", "cars").

query.description:
Natural-language query — movie title, event keyword, tour name,
theme like "beach getaway", etc.

territory.description: ISO country code (US, GB, etc.). Default US.

when.description: Optional ISO date filter (YYYY-MM-DD) for events.

agent_client.description: Optional — name of the calling agent (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.).

locale.description:
Optional BCP-47 locale ('en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', 'ja-JP', etc.).
Currently consumed by the 'experiences' vertical to localise the
Viator response and hand-off URL. Auto-detected from the query
when the language is unambiguous.

tools.name: search_all
tools.description:
Search every Agentorist vertical at once — the answer to "what's on?".

Use this when the user's request spans verticals or doesn't clearly name
one ("what's on tonight", "anything to do in Boston?", "Friday night
plans"). For specific single-vertical queries ("movies tonight",
"Italian restaurants"), `search_all` auto-narrows to the hinted vertical
so you don't waste calls.

Returns `results_by_vertical` keyed by movies/events/local, plus
`total_count` and `bookable_total` for quick summaries.

query.description: Natural-language query. Empty string is fine (= browse).

when.description: Optional time hint ("tonight", "weekend", or ISO date).

territory.description: ISO country code (US, GB, etc.). Default US.

agent_client.description: Optional — name of the calling agent.

locale.description:
Optional BCP-47 locale ('en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE', etc.).
Forwarded to verticals that localise their response (experiences).

tools.name: find_options
tools.description:
Find concrete bookable options for an item.

For movies: showtimes for the given film. For events: ticket classes.

item_id.description: ID returned by `search` (film_id, event_id), or a title for fuzzy lookup.

location.description: City, postcode, or "lat,lng" — required for movies.

agent_client.description:
Optional — name of the calling agent (Claude, ChatGPT,
etc.). Pass the SAME value across search → find_options → book so
the trust stack can link the booking to its prior discovery.

tools.name: book
tools.description:
Book an option (showtime, ticket class, etc.).

If a partner API is connected, completes the booking inline with a confirmation
code. Otherwise returns an affiliate deep link the agent should hand to the user.

agent_client.description: Optional — name of the calling agent (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.).

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List venues near a location, marked as bookable or not.

agent_client.description: Optional — name of the calling agent (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.).

tools.name: request_unsupported_booking
tools.description:
Log a booking request Agentorist can't yet fulfil.

This is the demand-intelligence engine. Every call here becomes a data point
sold to the venue as monthly missed-revenue insight. Optionally captures
email so the user is notified when the venue joins.

vertical.description: Which vertical the request belongs to.

venue_name.description: Name of the venue the user wanted.
